name: io.github.cyanheads/wikidata-mcp-server
description: Search and fetch Wikidata entities, execute SPARQL queries, and resolve external identifiers.

environmentVariables.name: WIKIDATA_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent string for Wikimedia requests. Wikimedia policy requires a descriptive value.

environmentVariables.name: WIKIDATA_SPARQL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Max time to wait for a SPARQL response in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: WIKIDATA_REST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Max time to wait for REST API responses in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
